hooks.command:
IN=$(cat); c=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input as $t | ([$t.file_path // empty] + [(($t.command // "") | if type=="array" then join(" ") else tostring end)] + ((($t.input // $t.patch // "") | split("
")) | map(select(startswith("*** "))))) | .[]'); if printf %s "$c" | grep -qE '\.(cpp|cc|cxx|hpp|hh|hxx|h|inl|ipp)([^A-Za-z0-9_.]|$)'; then s=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); if [ -n "$s" ]; then m="/tmp/cppmd-codex-$s"; [ -e "$m" ] && exit 0; touch "$m"; fi; [ -f "$HOME/.codex/CPP.md" ] && jq -n --rawfile g "$HOME/.codex/CPP.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:("You are working on C++ code. Follow this guide (~/.codex/CPP.md):

"+$g)}}' || :; fi
